events.evidence: At least 11 people are killed and dozens are injured in a bomb explosion at Kastrychnitskaya metro station in Minsk
Laurent Gbagbo is captured and arrested in Abidjan.
Japan is hit by a magnitude 6.6 aftershock one month after the main earthquake, knocking out power to Fukushima I for nearly an hour

label.note: Minsk bombing and Japan aftershock weigh on sentiment; Gbagbo capture is a partial positive.
